To find out how long it will take Bob to dig the hole, we need to follow two simple steps:

1. **Calculate the volume of the hole:** 
   The dimensions of the hole are 6 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 3 feet deep. 
   $$\text{Volume} = 6 \times 4 \times 3 = 72 \text{ cubic feet}$$

2. **Calculate the total time required:** 
   Since it takes Bob 3 seconds to shovel one cubic foot of earth, we multiply the total volume by the time per cubic foot:
   $$\text{Total time} = 72 \text{ cubic feet} \times 3 \text{ seconds/cubic foot} = 216 \text{ seconds}$$

All peer responses agree with this step-by-step reasoning and arrive at the exact same conclusion.

Final answer: 216
